description: LCARS-style Star Trek Adventures Second Edition dice roller. This is a client-only web tool, not a conversational agent: it exposes documentation and agent skills, but no A2A message endpoint. Roll a d20 task pool, track successes, critical successes, complications, and rerolls in a rules-accurate LCARS interface. Free, no accounts. A fan-made utility, not affiliated with Modiphius, CBS, or Paramount.
name: 2d20.space — Star Trek Adventures 2d20 Dice Roller

skills.description: Roll a d20 task pool for Star Trek Adventures 2nd Edition: Target Number, Difficulty, Focus, complication range, assists, Momentum/Threat bonus dice, and rerolls.
skills.name: Roll STA 2e task dice

skills.description: Track the Momentum and Threat economy around STA 2e rolls: how bonus dice are bought and how Momentum is generated from extra successes.
skills.name: Track Momentum and Threat

skills.description: Explain the 2d20 dice math: success odds at every target number, Focus impact, and Momentum generation at each difficulty.
skills.name: Explain 2d20 odds
